title: AS2 new on chained member expressions (e.g. new mx.transitions.easing.Strong())
description: compileNewExpr in compiler.ts likely handles only simple new ClassName() (identifier) but not dotted paths like new pkg.subpkg.ClassName(). Flash 8 tween class instantiation uses this pattern constantly. Fix: for NewExpr with a MemberExpr callee, emit chained GetMember calls to resolve the constructor, then ActionNewObject.
